details: Riverbed Cave Shrine Access: The self-manifested sanctum is located directly within the riverbed of the Manjeera River. Navigating the rocky riverbed and cave steps requires physical care.
River Safety & Railings: Senior citizens taking holy baths should strictly use designated safe ghats equipped with security chains and railings.
First Aid Clinic: A basic first-aid counter is active in the temple administrative block during general darshan hours.
